title: Single-Screen Compact Layout
changes: Condensed the hero/header so the logo, church name, motto and scripture use substantially less vertical space.
Reduced card height, gaps and icon footprint while preserving touch targets and readability.
Shortened the decorative wave, church information strip and footer.
Kept the seven-card two-column layout even on narrower phones to avoid unnecessary vertical scrolling.
Added extra compact rules for shorter phone screens so the main Hub is designed to fit in a single viewport on common mobile sizes.

title: Bible & Footer Refresh
changes: Removed the four-item bottom navigation and restored the compact v1.0.0-style footer with version, install, About, developer credit and copyright.
Replaced Conéctate with a bilingual Biblia / Bible card.
Added a Bible modal with Reina-Valera 1960 (RVR1960) in Spanish and King James Version (KJV) in English through BibleGateway.
Redes Sociales now uses recognizable Facebook, Instagram and YouTube brand marks with platform names and no Abrir/Open wording.
Replaced the previous mockup-like card icons with a cleaner custom monoline icon system.
Kept Zelle centered, Ministerios linked to https://mpdgi.org/ministerios, and YouTube inside Redes Sociales.
Kept Servicio en Vivo, Eventos and Recursos removed.

title: Reference UI Refresh
changes: Restored the official MPdG logo and refreshed the interface toward the approved mobile reference.

title: NFC Launch
changes: First public release of MPDGI Hub.
